text:
anya: Heads-up: proposing an end-to-end verification run for the marketplace onprem bundle: Snowflake external function -> Databricks batch transform -> Qdrant index. Purpose: exercise listing install, auth (KMS/HSM), and vector upsert performance before we open the dry-run with the partner.

jordan: Sounds good. Which versions and infra are we pinning for the test?

anya: Plan: Snowflake connector 1.10.x, DBX runtime 13.1, Qdrant 1.2 on the partner-like onprem image. Also test Redwood-optimized quantized embeddings path.

luis: Compliance flag: private listing requires a KMS endorsement and data residency note. Who will generate test keys for the onprem flow? :lock: 

samir: I can create ephemeral KMS keys in our test project and configure an HSM-simulated endpoint. Also will provision a peered VPC and a tiny dataset (~4k docs, anonymized).

kate: On the GTM side, what's the expected lead time from green-lit litmus to a joint customer-facing announcement? We need ~3 weeks for partner PMs and press. :calendar: 

anya: Conservative timeline: smoke + perf run by next Thursday, partner review within 5 business days, announcement slot ~3 weeks after partner sign-off. If any blockers surface in smoke, that pushes dates.

qdrant_ops: QA cluster: qdrant-onprem-qa.local:6333. We'll use snapshot retention=3d for this run to limit storage. Can bump QPS if needed.

jordan: Adding a minimal test snippet we'll include in the runbook for embedding -> upsert: 

```
# from DBX job produce embeddings
curl -s -X POST https://rbx-integ-3.jobs/api/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DBX_TOKEN" \n  -d '{"text":"example doc text"}' | jq -r '.embedding' > point.json
# upsert into qdrant
curl -s -X PUT "http://qdrant-onprem-qa.local:6333/collections/marketplace_test/points?wait=true" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @point.json
```

luis: Please add an automated latency gate: Snowflake external function p50 < 200ms and p95 < 400ms for <=512 token inputs, otherwise mark as high latency risk in the packet.

samir: Will wire up rbx-harness to run 250 small requests, concurrency=6, and emit p50/p95 + errors. Harness will also optionally toggle embedding provider (onnx vs remote API) to capture quality delta.

anya: Owners & next steps: 1) samir: provision KMS + VPC peering + harness (due Tue EOD). 2) jordan: DBX job + sample dataset + runbook snippet (due Tue). 3) qdrant_ops: apply retention policy & expose healthcheck (done). 4) luis: compliance checklist + enclave note for partner packet (due Wed AM). 5) kate: draft announcement timeline and PT slots for partner dry run (due Wed EOD).

marketplace-bot: Marketplace lint check: onprem-bundle manifest missing `kms_note` field (severity: medium)

anya: Good catch — I'll add kms_note to the manifest before the smoke.

kate: Wed 9:30 PT works for comms to join the smoke pass and draft messaging immediately after.

jordan: Question: do we run both ONNX and vendor-API embedding paths in the litmus or just ONNX to minimize external calls?

anya: Start with ONNX only to isolate infra/connector issues; run vendor-API after if we see a quality regression.

samir: I'll include a toggle in the harness and output recall@10 difference between providers.

luis: If smoke is green, I'll prepare a 1-page risk matrix (latency, kms, quantization, install complexity) for partner handoff.

anya: I'll upload the runbook draft shortly: https://redwood-internal/partnerships/onprem-marketplace/e2e-litmus (draft). Will post results here after the smoke.

qdrant_ops: :+1: ping here if you need higher write throughput on the QA cluster during the run window.

anya: Thanks everyone — running smoke Thu 09:30 PT. Will report back.
